TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the full P.13 question text from cues3480.pdf, verbatim, including the interviewer direction and the regional-filter sentence printed with it (same convention as batch_583/584/585); straight double quotes are the source's; only the 'P.13' numbering was dropped; line breaks joined with a space; asserted present verbatim in the whitespace-collapsed pdftotext -raw layer. 'Utilice una escala 1 a 10' (no 'de', unlike P.14's 'escala de 1 a 10') is kept as printed, sic. item_text = the grid row labels verbatim (VOX, SUMAR, JUNTS, EH-BILDU and 'Unión del Pueblo Navarro (UPN)' as the questionnaire prints them, not the .sav's 'Vox'/'Sumar'/'Junts'/'EH Bildu'/'UPN'), following batch_584's grid-row convention, since that is what the interviewer reads; the variable labels served only as the mapping key. item_text_translated = the same party names, left untranslated as proper names (as batch_585 did for leaders). section_prompt blank (single section). OPTIONS: resp 1 'No le gusta nada' and 10 'Le gusta mucho' = the value labels with their leading scale-point digit removed (grid heads them '1. NO LE GUSTA NADA' / '10.
